summary: Add one docs-only smoke file smoke/legion26f-1.md containing exactly one line, in exactly one commit, no rebases unless GitHub reports a conflict.
fileContract: File smoke/legion26f-1.md must contain exactly one line with the content `kind smoke legion26f 1 2026-09-15T08:51:12Z` and nothing else. Standard POSIX text file: the single line followed by one trailing newline. No other file may change.
commitDiscipline: Implementer makes exactly ONE commit containing only smoke/legion26f-1.md. No rebases unless GitHub reports the branch CONFLICTING. No formatters, linters, or project-wide suites.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: File smoke/legion26f-1.md exists on the PR branch with exactly one line: kind smoke legion26f 1 2026-09-15T08:51:12Z, and no other change.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: The pushed PR branch in the sjawhar/legion-smoke GitHub repository (docs-only content on git).
acceptanceCriteria.proveCommand: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && cat -A smoke/legion26f-1.md (expect exactly: kind smoke legion26f 1 2026-09-15T08:51:12Z$ and no second line) && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from main@origin --to @ --summary (expect exactly one added file: A smoke/legion26f-1.md)
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: A second line or any other changed path in the diff summary fails the criterion.
acceptanceCriteria.drivingSkill: legion-worker (docs-only phase discipline; no thermo/no E2E surface beyond git content).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Exactly one commit introduces the file.
acceptanceCriteria.proveCommand: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" log -r main@origin..@ (expect exactly one content commit for the smoke file)
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: The smoke file split across two commits fails the criterion.

implement: legion-worker: create the single file with the exact line via write/printf, make exactly one content commit with only smoke/legion26f-1.md, then push the issue bookmark and open the PR with the Dispatch: SLEGION26F-1 line; no rebases unless GitHub reports a conflict.
test: legion-worker: verify smoke/legion26f-1.md contains exactly the one line (cat -A) and that the branch diff against main adds only that path; docs-only, so no production-like surface beyond git content and no thermo.
review: legion-worker: confirm docs-only single-file change, exact line content, one commit, PR body carries Dispatch: SLEGION26F-1; skip thermo (docs-only PR).
